dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High-contrast, sharp pale-buff boundaries along the edges of dark-centered folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct transition line where the finer, lighter brown texture of the crown meets the darker, large-scale scalloped pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, high-contrast facial patch/mask is visible extending from the base of the beak toward the eye.
